title: Assessing the Role of Statins as an Adjunctive Anti-VEGF Therapy for Clinically Significant Macular Edema (CSME) in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

groups.description: Group A (randomized): three monthly loading injections of intravitreal ranibizumab 0.5 mg, then pro re nata over six months, with low-dose oral atorvastatin (10-20 mg); type 2 diabetes, NPDR with clinically significant macular edema; n from Table 1 header (patients).

Group B (randomized): three monthly loading injections of intravitreal ranibizumab 0.5 mg, then pro re nata over six months, with high-dose oral atorvastatin (30-40 mg); type 2 diabetes, NPDR with clinically significant macular edema; n from Table 1 header (patients).

exclusions.what: Table 4 BCVA (logMAR) by group at baseline, 3 and 6 months (T4!R3)
exclusions.reason: Same quantity as Table 3 printed again for the intergroup comparison; Table 3 cited instead
Text, not table cells (they agree with the cited Table 3 cells)

notes: Prospective randomized study (CTRI REF/2020/06/034527); both arms receive the investigational oral statin adjunct at two doses and no arm is without statin, so both are role treated.
Treatment 'combination': intravitreal anti-VEGF plus an oral drug (treatment type 'other') defines each arm.
BCVA in logMAR (Tables 2-4); best-corrected acuity stated in the Methods; no Snellen or decimal row.
Eligibility admitted treatment-naive eyes and eyes treated for CSME at least 3 months before enrollment; the composition of the groups is not reported, so prior_treatment is unstated.
n is the number of patients per group (Table 1 header); the number of study eyes per patient is not stated.
The Discussion states that patients could not follow the scheduled visit protocol because of the COVID-19 pandemic; missing-visit handling is not stated.
Central macular thickness, serum VEGF and injection counts are reported but not extracted.

series.notes: mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: continuous variables as means and standard deviations); visits labelled '3 months (10-14 weeks)' and '6 months (22-26 weeks)' dated at the nominal months 3 and 6; per-visit n not reported

mean ± SD (Statistical analysis: continuous variables as means and standard deviations); visits labelled '3 months (10-14 weeks)' and '6 months (22-26 weeks)' dated at the nominal months 3 and 6; per-visit n not reported
